source_type: reconstructed 72 cell aggregates; raw repeat values not resampled
eligibility: degenerate_repeats_5pct <= 3 of 30; all six cohorts included
bootstrap_unit: cohort; 6 clusters; all eligible method cells retained within sampled cohort
recommended_primary_reporting: Describe cohort-specific values and cell-weighted descriptive mean; remove inferential interval from primary manuscript. Any cohort bootstrap is exploratory pending a defensible cohort sampling frame.
limitations: Only six nonrandomly selected biomedical cohorts; exchangeability unsupported.
Method cells within each cohort are not independent cohorts.
The 435 pairwise ARIs entering each stability estimate are dependent and are not bootstrap units here.
Bootstrap uses aggregate cell metrics, not repeat-level uncertainty.
Historical bootstrap code paths differ and RNG consumption is order-sensitive.
